game.title: Need for Speed Heat
game.blurb: Street racing game set in Palm City, from Ghost Games, released 2019-11-08. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story from your arrival in Palm City onward. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.summary: Winning races, engine swaps, handling parts, tuning, wraps and plates.

chapters.title: Cops, Heat and REP
chapters.summary: Cop chases and takedowns, high-heat nights and REP levels.

chapters.title: Activities and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Billboards, street art, drift zones, long jumps, speed traps, three-star ratings and the Discovery Event.

chapters.title: Online and Crew
chapters.summary: Events with other players, crew time trials and crew level.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents are linked but no subpages exist. No Fandom page was found: "Need for Speed Heat" is missing on both nfs.fandom.com and needforspeed.fandom.com; marked unverified. 10 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, but "Get Shrimpin'" (2.3 percent) is probably not a story beat. The daily challenge, gas station and licence plate achievements fall into the racing chapter by default.
